variants.name: A local Monoid trait with fold and reduce
variants.idiom_name: trait Monoid { fn id() -> Self; fn combine(&self, &Self) -> Self; } with fold/reduce
variants.implementation_notes: A ~30-line trait that makes generic aggregation work over user types with a single impl. Derive it with a macro rather than hand-writing it per type, and add a property test for the two laws since nothing enforces them.
variants.code_sketch: fn fold<T: Monoid + Clone>(xs: &[T]) -> T { xs.iter().fold(T::id(), |a, b| a.combine(b)) }
pitfalls: The laws are unchecked; a bad impl type-checks.
Clone requirements push callers toward Rc/Arc or copying.
